*
 The Police-Inspector of Basavanagudi Women P.S. has filed chargesheet against Accused No.1 to 3 for the offences punishable U/s. 498A, 506 r/w/s 34 of IPC. & Sec.3 & 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.
2 . The criminal law has been set into motion based on the first information statement of Smt. Manasa C.

The gist of the prosecution case is that CW-1 married Accused No.1 on 12-12- 2010 at Sri Lakshmi Venkateshwara Kalyana mantapa,
Gavipuram, Guttahalli as per Hindu customs.

At the time of marriage, the parents of CW-1 have given to Accused No.1, 9 gms.
finger ring, 25 gms. gold neck chain, 150 gms. of gold ornaments to CW-1 Rs. Three lakhs cash and performed their marriage by  3  C.C.No.24688/2015 incurring Rs.8 lakhs in grand manner.

After the marriage, CW-1 started residing with Accused at No.296, 2nd cross, Ganganadi road, Brindavana nagar , Srinagar while residing at the instigation of Accused No-2, the Accused No.1 demanded CW-1 to bring Rs.2 lakhs for running GYM and harassed her, abused her in filthy words

later CW-1 went to her parents house for delivery, accused did not visit her even after she gave birth to a child, after her return to his house, accused failed to provide basic needs to child and CW-1 and drove away her out of his house and tortured CW-1 Manasa C vs Umesh L on 8 May, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/181117326/
2
both by physically and mentally in demand of additional dowry of Rs.Two lakhs.
Based on the said information, a case in Cr.No.11/2016 came to be registered against the accused for the aforesaid offences.
3. After completion of the investigation, the P.I of Basavanagudi Women P.S. has filed chargesheet against accused for the aforesaid offences.
On receipt of charge sheet, this court took cognizance of the alleged offences.
Pursuant to the issuance and service of summons, accused entered appearance and were enlarged on bail.

The prosecution papers was furnished to the accused as required U/s.207 of Cr.P.C.
 4  C.C.No.24688/2015  4.

Before framing charge an opportunity of being heard was provided to the accused and after hearing them and the prosecution and as there was sufficient materials, the charge for the aforesaid offences was framed and same was read over to the accused in the language known to them, to which, the accused pleaded not guilty and claimed to be tried.
The plea of the accused was recorded.
Thereafter, the matter was set down for prosecution evidence.
5. In order to prove the charges, the prosecution has examined PW-1 and got marked Ex.P.1 to P.5 documents.

As there was no any incriminating evidence appearing against the accused, the recording of Statement of Accused as required U/s.
313 of Cr.P.C., was dispensed with.

sentences.text: I have Perused the materials on record.

7. The following points arise for my determination:-
 1) Whether the prosecution proves beyond all reasonable  doubt that the accused persons caused physical and  mental cruelty to the complainant in demand of dowry  and threatened her and thereby accused have committed  the offences punishable U/s.498A, 506 r/w/s 34 of IPC.
 & Sec.3 & 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act?
 5  C.C.No.24688/2015  2) what order?
 8.

My finding to the above points are as under:-
 Point No.1 ........In the Negative.
 Point No.2........

As per final order, for the following:
 REASONS  9. POINT No.1 :- It is the fundamental principle of criminal jurisprudence that the prosecution has to prove its case beyond reasonable doubt.

In order to bring home the guilt of the accused,
the prosecution has examined one witness as PW-1 got marked Ex.P.1 to Ex.P5 documents.
Ex.P1 is the first information statement.
Ex.P.2 is the FIR.
Ex.P.3 is Wedding invitation card and Ex.P.4 and 5 are the marriage photos.

10. CW-9 was examined as PW-1 Smt.Kavitha G.M..She in her examination-in-chief has deposed that on 05-06-2016 CW-1 appeared in the police station and gave written complaint, she received complain at Ex.P.1 and registered case in Crime Manasa C vs Umesh L on 8 May, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/181117326/
4 No.11/2016 and sent FIR at Ex.P.2 to the court.

sentences.text:
PW-1 further deposed that on the same day, she received wedding invitation,
 6  C.C.No.24688/2015 which is marked at Ex.P.3 of CW-1 and accused NO.1 and marriage photos for records which are marked at Ex.P.4 and Ex.P.5 and handed over case records to PSI.
 11.

On appreciation of entire materials on record, it is apparent that CW-1 being the informant, key and material witness did not stepped into the witness box to depose about the incident,
which is fatal to the case of prosecution.
The available evidence on record is the evidence of PW-1 who is police personnel deposed about the part of the investigation done by her is only a formal in nature.
As there was no any incriminating circumstances appeared against the accused, the statement of accused as required U/s. 313 of Cr.P.C. is dispensed with.
Therefore, this court was pleased to reject the prayer of the learned Sr.APP to summon other chargesheeted witnesses.

Even, if the summons was issued to other chargesheeted witnesses, no purpose would be served as the material witness has given go-bye to her own statement and also the valuable time of the court would be saved.
As such other charge sheeted witnesses were dropped and prosecution evidence was taken as closed.

In the absence of evidence of the material witness,
this court cannot held that the accused have committed the alleged  7  C.C.No.24688/2015 offences.

The prosecution has failed to bring home the guilt of the Manasa C vs Umesh L on 8 May, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/181117326/
5 accused beyond reasonable doubt.
